source: Ed4 B.7.2.1 Step 2 (c) and Step 3, p.B-28; C.7.2 (p), p.C-100
description: A PHYSICAL LINK REQUEST from the node we called, on a link in use, makes a new link with fresh ARQ state, so the peer's new FSN 0 is delivered.
note: Conn 1 binds SAP 9 for ARQ (in order, no confirmation) and at 0 sends "ping" to SAP 9 at 0.0.1.3; the link is made as cas/make-caller-accepted, on PHYSICAL LINK ACCEPTED at 91000, this node the Caller, and "ping" goes out at 108000 as DATA-ONLY FSN 0 (dts.ack_wait/0.0.1.3 from 118350, dts.ack_wait_ms 60000). At 126000 the peer sends DATA-ONLY FSN 0 with "aaaa" (DELIVER IN ORDER, TX WIN LWE): nothing is missing before it, so it is delivered (C-0178), and RX LWE becomes 1. At 178350 our answer wait expires with "ping" unacknowledged, so it is taken to have failed (C-0904); at 181000 one transmission carries it again as a DATA-ACK acknowledging the peer (RX LWE 1), and a copy of that acknowledgement as an ACK-ONLY in the fill (C-1154). At 201000, from 0.0.1.3, a PHYSICAL LINK REQUEST (Ed4 set, octet 12, its C_PDU ID 1). The peer is the node we called and the link has carried its ARQ data, so this is no repeat of a request we answered: the peer no longer holds the link (B-0452; B-0214 covers the Called node). Our link is broken locally (as B-0324): link_state unlinked, D_CONNECTION_TERMINATED, which rejects the unacknowledged "ping" (C-0652, C-0866) and so stops dts.ack_wait and dts.ttd, and C_PHYSICAL_LINK_BROKEN, which ends the soft link and its timer (A-0199). The request is then handled as a new one: PHYSICAL LINK ACCEPTED queued (Ed4 echoed, B-0138). The burst ends at 202000, csma.vdcd_end 4000, LBT rule 1, contention 36000 ms; at 242000 the accept goes out, our C_PDU ID 1, and when that transmission ends at 247550 the link is made with this node as the Called node (B-0213, B-0400): link_state linked, D_CONNECTION_MADE with fresh window edges (C-0571, C-0782), cas.first_data/0.0.1.3 (B-0215) and the called node's soft link timers (A-0194, A-0197). At 261000 the peer, which also started afresh, sends DATA-ONLY FSN 0 with "dddd". With the old RX LWE of 1 it would have been a copy behind RX LWE, acknowledged but not delivered (C-1126); on the new link it is new data, delivered: the client gets "dddd", and cas.first_data stops (B-0215, B-0403). At 304000 the ACK-ONLY: RX LWE 1, no bitmap. Seed 0 draws uniform(16) = 15, 4, 15, 12, 11: contention waits 45000, 12000, 45000, 36000, 33000 ms (K-0080). Settings: cas.max_links, cas.link_request_timeout_ms 60000, cas.link_request_retries and cas.first_data_timeout_ms 120000. Fixture: preamble 600, flush 150, 25 bytes and 4800 ms a block, so an n-block transmission lasts 750 + 4800 n ms, and the EOT of a D_PDU starting in block b of n is ceil((4800 (n - b) + 150) / 500): 10, 20, 30 for 1, 2, 3 blocks to go (C-0104, C-1043). Addresses 0.0.1.2 (this node) and 0.0.1.3 take address size 3 (C-0133). A CAS-1 C_PDU of one octet in a type 8 D_PDU fills a block exactly, C_PDU IDs from 0 in each node's own sequence (C-1040), EOW 0. The SIS soft link times are unset, so they are derived from the answer wait (A-0321).
